dedup.scope: The public identity index, the retired-claims record, the current worklist, the manifest entry of the public item taken from the same source and the sibling card prepared from the same source were searched with the object names of this claim; only the independent statement named in the counted unit is counted.

compared.difference: Same source, different proposition: the counted public unit is the sharpness Proposition at source lines 358-360 with its own proof at 361-404, which claims that the two lower bounds are attained by complete uniform hypergraphs. The present card counts Theorem mainthmSaeed2 (source lines 301-309) with its own complete proof at 311-345; in the public unit this theorem appears only as retained context (manifest context span 301-309) and its proof is not retained there, so this is a different statement, not a repackaging of the counted unit.

compared.kind: sibling card from the same source
compared.difference: The sibling card counts Theorem mainthmSaeed, whose lower bound is |V(H)| - alt_r(H) with the alternation number; the present card counts Theorem mainthmSaeed2, whose lower bound is the equitable colorability defect ecd^r(H). The article separates them into two different sections, states at source lines 285-292 that the two quantities are not comparable (each of the three comparison signs can occur), and the two proofs must establish different facts about the augmented hypergraph: alt_r(H~) = alt_r(H) at source line 218 against ecd^r(H~) >= |V(H~)|-|V(H)|+ecd^r(H) at source lines 328-335.

compared.query: matching chromatic number, general Kneser hypergraph, colorability defect, alternation number, hypergraph edge colouring with frequencies
compared.difference: The identity-index search returned Kneser-graph items (970 orthogonality dimension, 185548 monophonic number, 185783 stable Kneser hypergraphs, 186215 clique number of xor-powers, 192125 spectral bounds, 196086 cocliques in flag Kneser graphs, 200051 metric dimension, 210127 reduced Smith group, 211457 Kneser Ramsey triangles) and colouring items (183123 critical edge sets, 178638 colouring defect of cubic graphs, 204817 upper chromatic number of generalized quadrangles). Every one of them counts a different invariant of an explicit graph or hypergraph family; none states a lower bound for a frequency-constrained matching chromatic number in terms of a colorability defect, and none uses the augmentation of a hypergraph by singleton-edged dummy vertices.
